notes.note: REASONED follow-up source impact review: the shared UI asset-serving entry now returns after headers/completion/destruction, including a delayed navigation readiness callback. The existing identity-response catch already contained its late-write exception; no new process crash is claimed for navigation. EXECUTED serialized-listener observation reaches the real identity probe and late answer, detects the pre-fix second header write, passes with the guard, and fails/recovers in a clean-tree byte-exact fault cycle. The media acquisition test import-order change is behavior-neutral and its lint gate was fault-qualified. Existing documentation remains accurate; unrelated authority, UI, release and historical capture claims are not requalified. Evidence: .kontourai/fix-r5/navigation-red3.log, navigation-green.log and faults.json.
